notes.title: Zcrew Latest DLC The Void Realm Is Now Free on Steam
notes.notes:
[h2]'The Void Realm'[/h2]
In this latest DLC,  you will face more fast-paced, more thrilling challenges,and of course, receive more generous rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/90cfa4505dfa2c7324d6debf66d907b416a34924.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/2c546d29b52d95e8034f13fe5bdb5b9f81b17e64.png[/img]

[h2]New Mode：Mysterious Devices and Mechanism[/h2]

You can challenge yourself in the brand new maps and survive in higher-level difficulties to receive better rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/d785c062fdbd6b60ed44d9b6ea8438f42f0ce760.jpg[/img]

As the level increases, in addition to the strength of the monsters, the mechanisms in the map will also become more complex.Not only are there randomly appearing debuffs such as slow and lightning strikes, but you also need to find the right passage and solve the map puzzle in order to defeat the boss within a time limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/d785c062fdbd6b60ed44d9b6ea8438f42f0ce760.jpg[/img]

[h2]Powerful Gears：Collect pieces of the set and dominate the field.[/h2]

Upon successfully clearing each level, you will first receive a piece from a random equipment set. There will be various sets of equipment for you to choose from, and whenever you equip 2, 4 or 6 pieces of the same set, you can trigger the set effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/4fd504edefc807836cd7c23f663368f00772dd1a.jpg[/img]

When you wear all 6 pieces of the set, powerful set effects can be triggered. And with character skills/talents/weapons，you can dominate the field with your own combat style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/049c53f30a11b297a8d1854064578e6b2bf35153.gif[/img]

[h2]New Avatars：Maid/Nurse.[/h2]

You can collect brand new avatars and have a different combat experience in the field!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/db867a21feed2a9b418a2ecf157f83c9541f4b73.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/b71603927bc076be8b720c8808dd9bc33c62d30a.gif[/img]

Whether it is dazzling Cyber soldiers, or stunning futuristic nurses, your can personalize your combat experience any time at your base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/b31251ea5d498611a4c20ae9a43df5561e2cb081.jpg[/img]

Zcrew's latest DLC “Void Realm” is now free and live on Steam for those who already purchased the game. .Good luck and enjoy the thrilling combat experience in this post-apocalyptic world.

notes.title: Welcome to ZCREW - an Indie Top-down Shooter game!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to ZCREW, Hunters![/b]

Thank you for joining our effort to save the world and reclaim Earth! Since our first rendezvous back on Earth, we’ve faced countless enemies in a world that was once our home. Returning with much more experience with each passing mission, we’ve made a number of upgrades and improvements including optimizations and additional missions and systems. The Early Access journey continues as we strengthen our forces with new content coming later this year, including all new gameplay, missions and events! 

While Hunters are blasting away Zombies and collecting resources, the engineers that support us back at base are working on new technology to give humanity an advantage - Project Mecha Force! In Mecha Force, our next major content update,  Hunters will have the ability to freely assemble and operate their own Mecha for battle. Giant robot suits? Yes, please! 

Check out the Roadmap of how far we’ve come along and what’s coming up next below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/cf0d9e626b39c468ea885d03cdc45a0d0c237d19.jpg[/img]

[b]New recruit? Here's the rundown![/b]
ZCREW is a top-down shooter game that supports up to 4 player co-op. In the world destroyed by an alien virus, you are an elite Hunter of the U.N.R - an apocalyptic salvation organization. Work alone or in a team to fight for the future of mankind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/259df239e38210b45737ecc104dd25067f2919b3.jpg[/img]

[b]Co-op makes everything much easier![/b]
In ZCREW, an alien virus has swept the world. Infected humans, animals and even insects have mutated and evolved into ravenous monsters. As Hunters, players are sent to Earth to eliminate monsters across ruined cities, desolate deserts and other decaying and dangerous environments. Complete tasks, obtain resources and rewards to strengthen humanity’s forces and empower your abilities in the quest to rebuild civilization step by step.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/98c1341805604d81bab0d6597fe0be0ed3d056a2.jpg[/img]

[b]Unique talents & customizable weapons[/b]
As a top-down apocalyptic shooter game, ZCREW offers a huge variety of weapon customizations. Weapon Attachments and Weapon Chips were added to the arsenal in our April patch earlier this year. Customizing your weapon can greatly enhance its stats in damage, accuracy, reload speed and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/8ddc894c1161246f0a0f98195298ce5f6aa57536.jpg[/img]

There are four different classes of Hunters, each with their own unique abilities. Players will have to strategize carefully before each mission and choose the best combination of classes for each type of mission, whether it is assassination, transportation, capture, or rescue mission. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/2874c1ca54c06c3576fb5c160c19f2c519ee92ef.jpg[/img]

ZCREW is now live on Steam Early Access! Are you ready to face the apocalypse? Start the hunt now!

Join the effort and find other Hunters in the Snail Games Official Discord here: http://discord.gg/8C9rmEmdT3
Be sure to read the rules and select the "ZCREW" role to access the ZCREW channels!

notes.title: Patch Notes 2/5/2021
notes.notes:
Hey there, Hunters!

We have a small update tonight with a few Quality of LIfe improvements to create a smoother experience for Hunters as we continue the mission to reclaim Earth!

Intel is key, and Dungeons now display details of material drops. Now you know exactly where to go to pick up what you need! A mission rewards UI has also been added. Review how your mission broke down, what you've gained, and pinpoint what you can do to further improve! We have also added level notifications and made it easier to invite your crew to join you on your missions! 

Most notably, we are also replacing the old Weapon Crafting system with a Weapon Growth system that we feel will be more intuitive and better fitting for the theme of the game. As highly enhanced humans in a world of rapid technological advancement, its only natural that our weapons grow with us as we hunt and conquer mission after mission. Damage numbers are also being added in game and different weapons will deal different damage to different enemies. Find the optimal combination to succeed!

Finally, we'd like to thank the Hunters who have joined our efforts in this Early Access stage. We look forward to hearing your ideas! We're still very early in the quest to save the world and you are a part of our evolution as we continue to develop the game! Please let us know how you feel about the UI, the characters, skills, and in particular, the game mechanics and controls! Of course, we need your help squashing bugs (and zombies) as well! We'll be checking out your reports on the Steam Discussions, Hunters! 

- Team ZCREW
